venira.speed_profile: fast; one bounded SQLite read (readonly, WAL-safe).
venira.use_when: you review what was done and why (the reason field), in this or an earlier session.

description:
Read recent audit-log rows, newest first. Filter by session_id, operation, outcome, since_unix; verify=1 checks the hash chain.
Use when: you review what was done and why (the reason field), in this or an earlier session.
Avoid when: you want live metrics (project_health).
Output: rows[], count, truncated, chain_ok (verify=1).

operation.description: Only rows for this operation (e.g. edit_file, shell_run).

since_unix.description: Only rows at or after this Unix timestamp (seconds).

verify.description: 1 verifies the audit hash chain and returns chain_ok; 0 disables verification.

name: project_read_audit
title: Read audit log
